svg.text: target_type + target_id: a logical reference to any table, no FK
PK primary key, FK foreign key, UK unique, UK* part of a composite unique key, gen virtual generated column (one-active-card rule: unit_id while OPEN or IN_PROGRESS, else NULL).
1 exactly one, N zero or many, 0..1 optional. Every foreign key shown is enforced by the database.
recorded_by, answered_by, raised_by, uploaded_by and audit_event.actor_id also reference app_user (lines left out for readability).
dark blue = transaction tables, light blue = reference data (not versioned), grey = demo users, orange = append-only audit.
database/01_domain_model/01_schema.sql. Column types, CHECK constraints and triggers are in that file and in docs/decisions/decision-log.md (D-009, D-012, D-013, D-025).
